name: Feature request
about: Something this project should do and does not
title: ""
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

### What is missing

What you cannot do today, in terms of the campaign you are trying to run rather
than in terms of a solution.

### The evidence that it is real

What you did instead, or what it cost you to work around. A request backed by a
campaign that actually ran is worth more than one backed by a guess, and saying
that you are guessing is a legitimate answer.

### What done would look like

The condition under which you would consider this finished. If you cannot write
it, say so, because that is usually a sign the request is still a problem
statement rather than a request.

### What it would cost

Optional, and useful even when rough. A new service, a new dependency, a new
question type or a new thing an operator has to configure are all costs this
project weighs against the restraint it is built on.
